latestVersion.changelog:
file-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the "文件整理 — 智能文件/桌面整理技能".
- Provides safe, intelligent, and reversible desktop/file organization with zero deletion or modification.
- Organization strictly via internal scripts; no direct command use or file planning before script execution.
- Refined multi-phase process: keyword matching, AI semantic analysis, fallback categorization, and desktop icon arrangement.
- Comprehensive operation log and structured report after every run, with full rollback support for all organization actions.
- Enforces strict safety rules, especially prohibiting shortcut movement and file/folder deletion.
